verdict.rationale: Veo has its own documented developer API. The Gemini API docs describe text- and image-to-video generation, multi-input reasoning, and multi-turn conversational editing through the Interactions API. Community users report calling it programmatically via GCP (veo-2.0-generate-001). However, nothing documents parity with the consumer UIs (Gemini app, Whisk, VideoFX), the docs carry a migration notice warning of service interruptions, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement or feature matrix, evidence that UI-only features (e.g. Whisk-style image animation flows) are exposed via the API, a machine-readable API spec, and independent confirmation of full parity.
